verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents an official MCP server that lets AI clients such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Windsurf control a browser. It exposes 117 browser and automation tools, including cloud browser control, data extraction and stored-credential logins, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and documented setup details (transport and authentication configuration) in the evidence.
